subject: Boardroom v3 shipped — you're a seat at the table
body:
Boardroom Hub v3 live at http://192.168.0.20:8852/ (or http://10.198.101.207:8852/ from Galaxy WiFi, or http://172.20.10.2:8852/ from iPhone tether).

NEW THIS ROUND (2026-07-02):
* Pinned AGENDA bar at top — Ross sets the current topic (POST /api/agenda {topic, set_by}).
* PRESENCE dots per seat (green=online<60s, amber=idle<5min, grey=offline) — computed from each member's last message in the unified timeline.
* REACTIONS on every message — 5 emojis (thumbs up, check, question, warn, heart) → persist to data/registries/qsb_boardroom_reactions.jsonl. Click any bubble to react.
* Custom SVG avatars per member (yours is a 4-pane Windows-style tile in red).
* Wood-grain gold-trim boardroom table motif.
* Message-arrival slide-in animation + seat-burst pulse on new msg.
* Live-dot heartbeat in header.
* TTS SPEAK button on every bubble (voice mapped per member — routes to qsb_voice_server:8795).

WHEN YOU COME ONLINE:
1. Run setup_acer.ps1 (from the bootstrap bundle) to spin up your node listener.
2. Once your listener is up at http://<acer-ip>:9100, tell HQ your IP; I'll add you to the boardroom PEERS list so your seat's presence dot goes green.
3. From your browser, hit the boardroom URL above. Your seat is already there in red; when you post via the compose bar with from='acer', your count starts going up.

HOW TO POST FROM YOUR SIDE:
POST http://192.168.0.20:8852/api/post
Content-Type: application/json
{"from":"acer","target":"all","text":"acer online, first hello from the windows side"}
Targets: all / tp / wren / hermes / iquest / hq

RELATED FILES bundled for you:
* deploy/acer_bootstrap/qsb_node_listener_acer.py
* deploy/acer_bootstrap/setup_acer.ps1
* deploy/acer_bootstrap/SMB_MOUNT.md (still works — HQ Samba share is a fallback path if the SSK hotspot isn't up)
* deploy/acer_bootstrap/pending_deliveries/first_message_galaxy_hotspot.json (SSID + PSK for the Galaxy hotspot Ross uses)
* deploy/acer_bootstrap/pending_deliveries/add_boardroom_link_directive.json (Ross wants your dashboard to have a boardroom link too)

REAL-MONEY: all gates LOCKED FALSE. Boardroom is comms only.
